list: Grand Theft Auto VI — PlayStation 5 trophies
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase before release. Guides are this entry's own words, written before the game is out: they say what each official description asks for, and flag — never assert — anything the description only suggests.

trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to do. Plan the whole run around the long poles below it — above all A Long Road (100% completion) — and let this one arrive last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission named in the description. Simply play the first mission through to its end; it is the natural first trophy of the game and the start of the story chain in the roadmap.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1. Keep following the story markers after Gone Fishing; the trophy lands when the chapter closes. A manual save at each chapter break is cheap insurance while nothing about replay is confirmed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Continue the story from Chapter 1's ending; the trophy lands when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3. Keep pushing the main story; the trophy lands when the chapter closes. If a strand or activity is about to be left behind by the plot, its own guide below says so.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4. By this point the map and most activity types should be open, which is a good moment to start the collectible and count trophies in the roadmap before the endgame.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, save into a separate slot: final missions are where choice-based trophies (see Actions Speak Louder) are decided, and until mission replay is confirmed a backup save is the only guaranteed way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: Endgame: keep a separate save before starting the final mission, so any ending choice the game offers can be revisited from it.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it is offered. Named-mission trophies like this one sit inside the chapter chain; if you are following the story markers you will be led to it.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist, so expect a setup-and-execution structure; complete it as part of the story chain and the trophy lands at its conclusion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play when it is offered. Follow the story markers; the trophy lands when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners when it is offered. Follow the story markers; the trophy lands when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown when it is offered. VCIA is the airport authority the list names again in Catch Me If You Can; the trophy lands when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it is offered. Follow the story markers; the trophy lands when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion. This is the long pole of the platinum: work the in-game completion checklist category by category, and let the other trophies feed it — story, strands, collectibles, stunts, races and activities all count toward the same percentage. Leave the final percentage points for last and re-check the checklist whenever a category stalls.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are a counted grind, so start them early and clear them region by region as the story opens the map, instead of leaving all 250 for the endgame; the counter in this tracker holds your place between sessions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every type of activity at least once: as each new activity icon appears on the map — races, ranges, fishing and the rest — do one round of it instead of walking past. The trophy lands when the last untouched type has been tried.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them. Work range by range and challenge by challenge, learning each weapon's handling on the way; a silver that is close is worth immediate retries while the course is fresh in your hands.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win — not just finish — a Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. Learn each course with a practice run first, then chase the win; tick locations off in the counter notes as you clear them.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Spread your wins across the map as new race series open, and bring a vehicle suited to each class instead of forcing one car through all of them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the named rival, in his fishing challenge. Learn the fishing activity on ordinary catches first (it also counts toward Master of None), then take Cal's challenge once the mechanics are comfortable.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade cabinet you find. Pick the shortest game on offer if several cabinets exist; a partial play does not count, so settle in for one full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's stranger strand to its end and finish his final mission. Stranger strands open as side markers across Leonida; finishing strands like this one also builds Strangers & Freaks, which needs eight completed strands.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work Kenton's stranger strand to its end and finish his final mission. Keep returning to his marker as new episodes unlock; the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work Billy's stranger strand to its end and finish his final mission. Keep returning to his marker as new episodes unlock; the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight whole mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named strands on this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of them; pick up every other stranger marker you pass so the remaining strands are already under way.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work Randy's stranger strand to its end and finish his final mission. Keep returning to his marker as new episodes unlock; the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work Tyrone's stranger strand to its end and finish his final mission. Keep returning to his marker as new episodes unlock; the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Treat the spots as a collectible set: sweep them region by region alongside exploration for The Goodtime State, and note each finished region so none is left hiding at the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal it names. Prepare before the hunt — a suitable weapon and transport — since a unique animal is a one-animal target rather than a count.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards. Cards are found across Leonida, so collect as you travel rather than hunting cold at the end; keep the counter on sets finished, and chase the missing cards set by set once the map is fully open.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. This is a coverage grind in the same family as the card sets: work district by district, keep the counter running, and pair the sweep with exploration and meditation spots so the trips overlap.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges accumulate from play you are already doing for other trophies, so check the challenge list whenever you are near a round number and mop up the shortest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you — the game follows two protagonists, Lucia and Jason, as Rockstar's official page and trailers announce — raise a four-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and let the stars drain until you have fully escaped. Do it somewhere with alleys, water or a vehicle swap nearby rather than in the open.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI official page and Trailer 2 (the two protagonists, Lucia and Jason)
trophies.watchNote: Needs your partner present: the game's two announced protagonists. If the story ever separates them late, do this while both are available.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time: the chain breaks if the heat fully drops between shops. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the stars are still up.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI official page and Trailer 2 (the two protagonists, Lucia and Jason)
trophies.watchNote: Needs your partner present, like Hot Together; attempt it while both protagonists are available and travelling together.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting in (or otherwise registering) each new model you meet. Variety lives in different districts and at different hours, so swap cars as you travel instead of keeping one favourite; rare models are worth a detour whenever one passes.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single activation of Combat Focus. Set the shot up first: gather or wait for a group of five or more, position with a loaded weapon, then trigger Combat Focus once and work the group before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport the list also names in VCIA Takedown. Read plainly, that means leaving by air outside any scheduled plan — taking off in an aircraft on your own initiative. If a mission brings you to VCIA, that visit is the natural moment to attempt it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: The wording suggests a one-off moment at VCIA rather than a repeatable errand; if a story mission takes you there, try it then, and keep a save from before the mission.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not steps — hidden trophies on this list are written that way. The working reading: the Rhino is the series' long-standing name for its tank, so get into a Rhino and make some heat in it. If it has not popped after a proper rampage, revisit this one once community knowledge exists; nothing more specific can honestly be said before release.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected: no alarms tripped, no witnesses reporting you. Scout the store first, plan the exit before you go in, and treat a spotted attempt as a rehearsal — leave, reset, and run it clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time — a vault only counts once you have got away. Treat each robbery as its own heist: preparation, entry, and an escape route planned before the first shot or alarm.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the take. Stop or breach the truck somewhere your getaway is already pointed the right way, grab the money fast, and lose the heat before checking it counted — the escape is part of the requirement.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida — every region uncovered. Work the map's edges and water as well as its cities, and combine the sweep with meditation spots, cards and WAiNK locations so one long tour serves four trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI official page (the state of Leonida and Vice City)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang — every gang on the list needs a turn, not the same one repeatedly. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit; the last unrobbed gang is usually the one whose territory you visit least.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Read plainly: at Ocean Beach, buy or accept a cocktail and take in the view. Because the wording sounds like a scripted moment, try it whenever the story puts you on Ocean Beach, and again in free roam if it does not pop there.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: Reads like a moment in a specific scene rather than a repeatable errand; if the story takes you to Ocean Beach, linger there — and keep chapter saves so you can return to the scene.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive through its glass front instead of leaving by the door, 'in classic style'. If the story places you in a showroom, that is the moment; in free roam, take a car from inside a showroom and exit through the window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: Set-piece wording: if a mission puts you inside a vehicle showroom, drive out through the glass rather than the door, and keep a save from before that mission.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the bowling alley the description names — Kolt & Associates' — and bowl there, following through on the visit: play the bowling activity at that specific alley rather than any other. The name is shown as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague, as the hidden entries on this list are: it gives no steps, and inventing some would be guessing dressed as guidance. Its words point at the two protagonists' partnership, so if it has not unlocked by the end of the story, revisit it then — this guide will be updated once the game is out and the trigger is known.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI official page and Trailer 2 (the two protagonists, Lucia and Jason)

trophies.guide: This trophy turns on choices — 'for better or worse' says the game remembers them. Until the choice points are known, protect yourself structurally: keep rotating manual saves before major story decisions, so any branch can be revisited without replaying the whole game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: The strongest caution flag on the list: the description is about choices, so a decision may lock this in or out. Keep rotating manual saves before big story decisions.

trophies.guide: Read plainly, this one wants a second attempt to succeed where a first failed: when something goes wrong — a race, a hunt, a job — retry it and win rather than reloading an old save to erase the failure. The description names no event, so treat every clean retry as a candidate.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
trophies.watchNote: The wording implies failing at something once and succeeding on the retry; if a first attempt at an event goes wrong, push for the second attempt instead of reloading.

trophies.guide: Another deliberately vague hidden description: it promises a strange event, not a checklist step. Series tradition points at something unexplained out in the wilds of Leonida, but that is atmosphere, not a location — explore off the beaten path, and if it has not popped by 100%, revisit this guide after release, when the event is documented.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Read plainly: knock people down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with fists or a melee weapon rather than a gun. 'Ten Pin' is the bowling joke on ten victims. Line up a crowded pavement, keep the speed moderate, and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. This is a money total, not a single score: route marked bills to your contacts whenever you hold them instead of spending them, and let the counter accumulate across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Ordinary play gets much of this — vehicles, clothes, weapons, services — so do not hoard cash early; if you finish the story short of the mark, the endgame's expensive purchases close the gap quickly.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on sale in Leonida. Garages are a money sink, so this pairs with the earning side of the game; sweep the property listings once your income is steady and buy the stragglers district by district.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app the description names. Register vehicles as you acquire them rather than in one batch at the end, and prefer models you will actually keep, since registration is about your own fleet.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PlayStation), as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase
